instruction: Merge the contents of all .txt files from the VSCode project folder into a single LibreOffice Writer document saved as "spaced_doc.docx" on Desktop. Do not insert separators between files. Set the line spacing to 1.5 for the entire document.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5)
